chapterTitle: Federal Board Annual Exam Simulator 08 (Specialized Simulator A - Lecturer Nimra Abid)
subject: math-10

questions.question: The transpose of a row matrix is a:
questions.explanation: Transposing a 1 × n row matrix interchanges rows and columns into an n × 1 column matrix.

questions.question: The inverse of a matrix exists if and only if it is a:
questions.explanation: A matrix inverse A⁻¹ = Adj(A)/|A| exists if and only if |A| ≠ 0 (non-singular).

questions.question: If k is any scalar, then (k A B)ᵗ is equal to:
questions.explanation: By properties of matrix transposition: (AB)ᵗ = Bᵗ Aᵗ, so (kAB)ᵗ = k Bᵗ Aᵗ.

questions.question: For a square matrix A = [a_ij], if all a_ij = 0 for all i and j, then A is a:
questions.explanation: A matrix whose every entry is 0 is defined as the null (zero) matrix.

questions.question: The mathematical constant π is a/an:
questions.explanation: π has a non-terminating and non-repeating decimal expansion, making it an irrational number.

questions.question: A number which has a finite decimal part is called:
questions.explanation: Decimals with a finite number of digits after the decimal point are terminating decimals.

questions.question: The multiplicative identity of a complex number (x, y) is:
questions.explanation: The number 1 + 0i = (1, 0) is the multiplicative identity for all complex numbers.

questions.question: The value of i²³ + i⁵⁸ + i²¹ is:
questions.explanation: i²³ = i²⁰ · i³ = 1(-i) = -i; i⁵⁸ = i⁵⁶ · i² = 1(-1) = -1; i²¹ = i²⁰ · i = 1(i) = i. Sum = -i - 1 + i = -1.

questions.question: Every real number is a/an:
questions.explanation: Any real number x can be written as x + 0i, so ℝ ⊂ ℂ.

questions.question: |z₁ z₂| is equal to:
questions.explanation: The modulus of a product of complex numbers equals the product of their moduli: |z₁ z₂| = |z₁| |z₂|.

questions.question: The linear function f(x) = ax + b becomes the identity function if:
questions.explanation: The identity function f(x) = x requires coefficient a = 1 and constant b = 0.

questions.question: A constant polynomial is also called a:
questions.explanation: A non-zero constant c = c·x⁰ has degree 0.

questions.question: What is the x-intercept of every point on the y-axis?
questions.explanation: The y-axis is the line x = 0; every point on it has x-coordinate zero.

In the complex plane, imaginary points (pure imaginary numbers) are drawn on the:
questions.explanation: In an Argand diagram, the vertical y-axis represents the imaginary axis.
